name: DealDeskingWorksheet
tagline: Desk every vehicle deal in Power Apps – price, trade, finance & lease payment grid, gross and manager approval in one control.
description: A complete deal-desk app for dealerships: structure selling price, discounts, rebates, trade equity, fees and tax; compare finance, lease and cash; present a down-payment × term payment grid; keep front and back gross inside desk rules with a manager approval queue; and keep every re-desk as a comparable deal version. Works on canvas collections and data sources, model-driven views and Power Pages (Web API).
features: Finance amortisation and lease (money factor, residual) payments
Down payment × term payment grid with approval highlighting
Trade allowance vs ACV vs payoff with negative-equity handling
Front gross, back gross (F&I + reserve), PVR and closing ratio KPIs
Configurable desk rules: min gross, max discount, max negative equity, max term
Rule-checked status pipeline with drag and drop and keyboard moves
Manager approve / send back with comments
controlType: standard (2 controls: data-set + Power Pages field)
